updates.closure_rationale: The previously missing cacheable cold-start integration is now implemented: exact shared linker reservation, separate M7 WBWA/M4 noncached MPU maps, full set/way invalidation, dirty-line initialization/clean and one-way peer release. Actual native/model executions and selected target links are separate from required physical observations.
evidence_limits: Author-assisted finite executions are not independent learner assessment or absolute mastery.
See receipt source fingerprints and individual command scope; physical hardware is never inferred from models or QEMU.
H745 MMIO adapters are compiled/linked, not executed on silicon; register traces and digital cuts are models.
H745 flash has32-byte data/ECC program words; the earlier4/8-byte bit-clear model is not a physical target contract.
Selected cold H745xI/BCM4=0 fixed vector profile; no warm remapping or peer restart
Host and MPS2 execute the declared original register/cache model; neither observes STM32 coherency
Eight actual selected target link/audits, no physical target execution
No physical DMA, flash, power cut, device identity or silicon errata qualification
Imported cold-start TU keeps its existing misleading-indentation diagnostic exception; new sources have no warning suppression
The eight selected H745 images are compiled/linked only. Four MPS2 executions run an original register/cache-state model on Cortex-M CPUs, not STM32 cache/HSEM hardware.
The selected cold-start premise forbids DMA or other masters owning the line; previous DMA reservation requirements remain caller obligations.
A bounded author-team source review found a 9..15 MPU-region admission mismatch. Exact 8-or-16 admission, rejection regression and a causal mutant now pass; this is not independent human review.
